title: Carshiga Runta
intro: Hoggaamiye awood leh, oo loo yaqaan xigmaddiisa weyn iyo carshigiisa cajiibka ah, ayaa farriin sir ah ka helay ilo aan la garanayn. Isgaarsiintan lama filaanka ah waxay caqabad ku tahay caqiidadooda iyo awooddooda, taasoo ku riixaysa safar diblomaasiyadeed oo tijaabin doona caqligooda ugu dambayntiina horseedi doonta baraarug ruuxi ah oo qoto dheer. Ma ogaan kartaa aqoonsiga madax-bannaanidan iyo dhacdooyinkii beddelay boqortooyadooda oo dhan?
clues: Aniga iyo dadkayguba waxaan caabudi jirnay qorraxda, annagoo raacayna jidkii awowayaasheen.
Shimbir, hoopoe, ayaa ahayd farriinta aan la fileyn ee ii keentay warqad ka timid hoggaamiye awood leh.
Si aan u tijaabiyo xigmadda qofka soo diray, waxaan diray hadiyado qiimo leh, laakiin waa la soo celiyay, maadaama qofka soo diray uu ka haystay Alle hanti aad uga badan.
Kahor intaanan xitaa gaarin barxadda qofka soo diray, carshigaygii quruxda badnaa si mucjiso ah ayaa loogu qaaday halkaas iyadoo ilbiriqsi ah.
Markii aan imid, waxaa la i weydiiyay in carshiga la qaaday uu aniga ii yahay, waxaana ku jawaabay, 'Waxay la mid tahay sidii inuu isagu yahay kan.'
Waxaan galay hool weyn oo leh dabaq aan u qaatay barkad biyo ah, daqiiqaddaas layaabka lehna, waxaan isku dhiibay Nabi Suleymaan oo la socda Ilaahay, Sayidka caalamka.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
